description: This file implements the functions for managing an HTTP Chunked Object, including creation, initialization, and removal, within a network service system. It defines how the object is constructed, how it manages its internal state, and how it interacts with other components in the HTTP processing layer.

classes.name: HTTP_MBO_CHUNKED_OBJECT
classes.description: Struct representing the HTTP MBO Chunked Object with function pointers and state variables for handling chunked transfer encoding.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE HttpMboChkCreate(ANSC_HANDLE hContainerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hOwnerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hAnscReserved)
methods.description: Constructs and initializes a new HTTP MBO Chunked Object.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS HttpMboChkRemove(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Destroys the HTTP MBO Chunked Object, freeing resources.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS HttpMboChkEnrollObjects(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Enrolls the necessary subordinate objects for the chunked object.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS HttpMboChkInitialize(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Initializes the member fields and function pointers of the chunked object.
